title: Two deposits show their total in the deposit message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, holding two deposits taken under customer B, $10.00 and $15.50.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Hover over the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "This work order has $25.50 in deposits from [customer B's name]. Reverse them, change the Bill To, then take the deposits again under the new Bill To."
  • The total is $10.00 + $15.50 = $25.50.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R7: “M1 names the total not reversed and the customer it was taken from, or "[N] customers" when there are several.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “M1 | Same, several deposits | "This work order has [$total] in deposits from [customer]. Reverse them, change the Bill To, then take the deposits again under the new Bill To." | Same as above”
